purpose: Refer politely or formally to an occasion for doing something.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express feelings speak politely show respect
V dictionary / た + 折に; N + の折に
Please stop by when you are in the area.
I visited my former teacher when I returned home.
I will return the book when we next meet.
formation: V dictionary / た + 折に; N + の折に
restrictions: Often appears in invitations and requests involving future visits.
mistake: It is an occasion expression, not necessarily a physical fold.
